entities.summary: Haruna Iddrisu is a Ghanaian politician who is currently the Minister for Education of the Republic of Ghana. He is a member of the ninth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing Tamale South. A member of the National Democratic Congress, he served as Minority Leader in Ghana's Parliament from 2017 to 2023
